gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-old-sou: Bold, unshaded letterforms up top, with no pen swell anywhere. Noto Sans Old South Arabian follows in a plain sans whose curved strokes stop short before turning inward, giving the heading room to lead.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian runs loose, its curves never knotting at the ends. Bellota Text is the one to lean on for punch, with outlines that never swell, while the sans takes over wherever you want quiet, approachable text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ojuju: Ojuju reads like lightly flexed spring wire, its wide s curves barely curling in and its curves a touch heavier than the joins. And Bellota Text brings the opposite habit: no thick-thin shift at all, which is what makes the two distinct.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-overpass: Bellota Text has no calligraphic shading, just open, confident curves that look carved rather than written. Overpass takes the lower rung, a sans whose e letters never blur, and it would hold up better than the heading if the type got small.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-palanquin: Palanquin reads with curved letters whose mouths stay wide and unclosed, which gives a line plenty of breathing space. Bellota Text earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-philosopher: Bellota Text draws every stroke at a single thickness, joints meeting without thinning or bulging. Philosopher counters with a sans that has plenty of daylight inside its curves and a faint charcoal-like shadow, which is the pair's most telling difference.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-pontano-sans: Contemporary in feel, Bellota Text turns its corners without any pressure swell, and its heading shapes stay crisp and open. Pontano Sans sets a plain sans with wide c terminals beneath, so paragraphs keep moving.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans reads approachably, with c forms that curve like open arcs and keep every word easy to scan. Give its size the attention.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-quattrocento-sans: Bellota Text opens with commanding, contrast-free strokes from stem to terminal. Quattrocento Sans carries the paragraphs as a plain sans, leaving gaps that stop c from looking like o, so a long page keeps its footing without tiring.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-reddit-sans: Distinctive is the word for Bellota Text, with open c, e, and s shapes and not a trace of calligraphic shading. Reddit Sans follows with a wide gap at the e terminal and uniform thickness, so a longer passage moves along smoothly.
